third_level_findings.root_cause: duplicate-unit rebuild could emit 'Unità duplicate' blocking errors that v1-self-check did not include in congUnresolved because it counted only unresolved strings prefixed by a conguaglio sheet name

association_rule: nome compatibile + stessa posizione relativa + almeno un vicino strutturato sopra e/o sotto confermato + nessuna contraddizione strutturata = associazione automatica; righe-note prive di interno/piano/SUB non sono usate come vicini

CAPUANO ANIELLO: associazioni già corrette preservate, EUR 158.99 e EUR 320.75

GALA COSTRUZIONI SRL: riga storica posizione 11 riconosciuta come attuale variante JOSEPH OMORS; interno 9 EUR 3792.62; BOX EUR 301.09 ed EUR 78.12 separati per posizione/vicino superiore; righe-note finali senza struttura escluse dal controllo vicini

drive_revalidation_20260912.conclusion: The real Excel snapshots used by the V3 audit remain current at the time of the Android OAuth-harness investigation.

android_live_attempt.failure_point: Pressing AGGIORNA when a fresh Google OAuth token is required
android_live_attempt.oauth_code_comparison: drive-sync-v1 stable and drive-sync-v3 test use the same CLIENT_ID, Drive readonly scope, GIS initTokenClient configuration and requestAccessToken prompt
android_live_attempt.interpretation: The failure is isolated to the Android TEST harness OAuth context and is not evidence of a V3 accounting/association regression.

pending_gate: Do not promote V3 runtime logic to stable without explicit user authorization. The accounting/data gate is green on current real Drive data; the separate Android TEST-harness fresh-OAuth gate is blocked by Google invalid_request origin=null and must not be misreported as a V3 calculation failure.
